settings.heading: Every business starts in a small room.
settings.text: Scroll to watch one day of a new cookie business, from the first idea to the first orders.

chapters.heading: A small idea
chapters.text: She bakes the best cookies anyone she knows has tasted. Every morning starts with the same thought: what if strangers could order them?

chapters.heading: Finding CHARGIX
chapters.text: One search, one site, three fixed prices. She picks Business Launch: the store, the brand, a 3D scene and her socials, set up for her.
chapters.label: See the packages

chapters.heading: The kitchen becomes a bakery
chapters.text: She sends her project form and clears the counter. CHARGIX starts on the store.

chapters.heading: First batch
chapters.text: Mix, scoop, twelve on the tray, into the oven.

chapters.heading: CHARGIX builds, she bakes
chapters.text: Brand, product pages, a 3D gift box and Spanish pages come together on the screen while the first batch comes out golden.

chapters.heading: The store goes live
chapters.text: Sweet & Co., designed and launched with Business Launch. It is a made-up brand, built for this story.
chapters.label: See the demo store

chapters.heading: Demo orders, packed by hand
chapters.text: Each order gets a box, four cookies and a ribbon.

chapters.heading: The next morning
chapters.text: Boxes ready by the window. From a thought on the sofa to a business that ships. Your turn.
